description: Questions from across your integrations that are still waiting on you, grouped by how urgent they are.

data.headline: One line summarising the whole sweep, e.g. "4 people are blocked on you, 9 questions total".
data.generatedAt: Human-readable timestamp for when the sweep ran.
data.empty: Set to true when nothing is open, so the report says so explicitly.

groups.name: Group heading, e.g. "Blocking someone else".
groups.note: Optional one-line explanation of what belongs in this group.

items.id: Stable id for this question, so it can be matched against the previous run.
items.question: What is actually being asked, in one plain sentence.
items.asked: When they asked, e.g. "6 days ago".
items.source: Where it came from, e.g. "GitHub" or "Slack".
items.answer: Candidate answer, or empty if it needs your judgement.
items.link: URL to the original message or thread.
items.isNew: True when this question was not present in the previous run.
